findings.title: Three-Hop Proxy Pattern Creates Runtime Overhead
findings.root_cause: Plugin resolution uses 3-hop pattern: DIContainer → PluginResolver → registry lookup → signature inspection
findings.impact: Every factory call performs registry lookup (O(1)) + signature inspection (O(params)) + isinstance checks; signature inspection not cached (~2-5ms per call)
findings.recommendation: Cache signature() results at registration time in PluginRegistry, not at factory call time

findings.title: Type Erasure in DIContainer.scan_options
findings.root_cause: DIContainer Protocol erases implementation; 50+ functions use 'di: object | None' and recover via cast()
findings.impact: 15+ cast() operations across scanner_extract; mypy cannot validate; silent failures if non-DIContainer passed
findings.recommendation: Replace duck-typing with explicit type hints; use 'di: DIContainer | None' parameter

findings.title: Optional Plugin Returns Create Silent-Failure Surface
findings.root_cause: 11 of 17 plugin factory methods return None by default; not truly optional, just unimplemented stubs
findings.impact: Call sites cannot distinguish optional plugins from unimplemented ones; 8+ defensive null checks; future refactors may accidentally delete plugin implementations
findings.recommendation: Classify plugins as RequiredPluginMarker vs OptionalPluginMarker via Protocol

findings.title: Incomplete ServiceLocator Decomposition
findings.root_cause: ServiceLocator only implements factory_event_bus(); 5 service factories remain in DIContainer (factory_scanner_context, factory_variable_discovery, factory_feature_detector, factory_variable_row_builder, factory_blocker_fact_builder)
findings.impact: DIContainer still owns 40% of factory lifecycle work; decomposition goal not achieved; circular reference pattern (DIContainer → ServiceLocator → DIContainer)
findings.recommendation: Move all 5 remaining service factories from DIContainer to ServiceLocator; use centralized SCAN_OPTION_DEPENDENT_CACHE_KEYS list

findings.title: DIContainer Type Coupling to PluginRegistry
findings.root_cause: DIContainer imports and directly references PluginRegistry type; creates upward coupling (scanner_core → scanner_plugins)
findings.impact: Tight coupling violates layer boundary; changes to PluginRegistry require DIContainer changes; difficult to test DIContainer in isolation
findings.recommendation: Replace direct PluginRegistry type with HasPluginRegistry Protocol; use TYPE_CHECKING import

findings.title: Implicit Platform-Key Resolution Path
findings.root_cause: Platform key resolution uses implicit multi-path ordering (scan_pipeline_plugin > policy_context > platform > registry default); logic duplicated in PluginResolver
findings.impact: 3 config sources compete for precedence (ambiguous); if scan_pipeline_plugin set, platform is silently ignored; tests must cover all 4 paths + error case; PluginResolver duplicates logic (lines 54-60)
findings.recommendation: Centralize with PlatformKeyResolver class using explicit if-elif chain; document precedence clearly

findings.title: Cache Invalidation Fragility
findings.root_cause: Cache invalidation keys hardcoded in 2 places with different lists: _SCAN_OPTION_DEPENDENT_CACHE_KEYS = {feature_detector, variable_discovery}; ServiceLocator hardcodes [scanner_context, variable_discovery, feature_detector]
findings.impact: Inconsistency between invalidation lists; potential cache staleness bugs; adding new cache key requires updating 2+ locations; no test validates coverage
findings.recommendation: Use class-level factory registry with metadata ('invalidate_on_scan_options' flag); dynamically compute invalidation keys

findings.title: Policy Bundle Resolution Scattered Across 8 Modules
findings.root_cause: Policy resolution logic duplicated across modules; no centralized PolicyManager; 15+ call sites manually fetch prepared_policy_bundle
findings.impact: Difficult to track policy lifecycle; if schema changes, 8+ modules must be updated; policies are unowned
findings.recommendation: Create PolicyManager class to centralize policy access and validation (aligns with g84 Initiative 2)

findings.title: Error Contract Not Defined for DIContainer Failures
findings.root_cause: DIContainer raises ValueError and PrismRuntimeError inconsistently; no error contract definition; detail dict structure varies
findings.impact: Callers cannot reliably catch DIContainer-specific errors; error handling inconsistent across call sites; mypy cannot enforce contract
findings.recommendation: Define DIContainerError base class with subclasses (DIRegistryNotFound, DIFactoryOverrideFailed, DIPluginResolutionFailed); use consistently

findings.title: Mock/Override Dispatch Logic Duplicated in DIContainer and PluginResolver
findings.root_cause: DIContainer checks mocks and overrides before delegating; 8-12 similar if/elif chains; PluginResolver only does registry lookup despite documentation claiming it orchestrates mock/override
findings.impact: Unclear responsibility split; if new plugin factory added, mock/override logic must be duplicated in DIContainer; 8-12 similar code blocks
findings.recommendation: Consolidate dispatch by passing request to PluginResolver.resolve_plugin(plugin_name, fallback_factory)

findings.title: Circular Reference Pattern in DIContainer → PluginResolver → DIContainer
findings.root_cause: DIContainer instantiates PluginResolver and ServiceLocator in __init__, creating circular reference; both hold self._di references; PluginResolver calls back to self._di.plugin_registry
findings.impact: Dependency direction unclear; difficult to trace initialization; if DIContainer.__init__ fails, partially-constructed resolvers remain; garbage collection deferred
findings.recommendation: Use lazy initialization via @property or external wiring; defer resolver instantiation until first use

findings.title: Implicit Event-Bus Factory Return Type
findings.root_cause: factory_event_bus() uses deferred import, but circular-dependency reasoning not documented
findings.impact: Future maintainers may not understand why import is deferred; may accidentally move import to module-level
findings.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining circular dependency

findings.title: Unused Module-Level Helper (_PlatformKeyRegistry)
findings.root_cause: Protocol _PlatformKeyRegistry defined but used only once in resolve_platform_key(); not referenced in type hints elsewhere
findings.recommendation: Either expand usage, remove, or move to protocols_runtime.py if foundational

findings.title: Logging Not Emitted for DIContainer Diagnostic Events
findings.root_cause: DIContainer factory methods raise errors but don't emit logger.error() before raising; inconsistent with logging in di_helpers.py
findings.impact: DIContainer failures not logged; no audit trail of factory override failures; difficult to debug without debugger
findings.recommendation: Add logging to key factory methods (_call_factory_override, _construct_runtime_plugin)

findings.title: DIContainer.clear_cache() and clear_mocks() Public API Not Documented
findings.root_cause: Public methods for clearing cache and mocks intended for testing only, but not marked as such
findings.impact: Future developers may think these are runtime APIs
findings.recommendation: Add [TESTING ONLY] marker to docstrings or move to test-only helper class

summary.recommended_action: Proceed with decomposition; findings align with g84 initiative goals; address FIND-004 first (critical path blocker)

escalation.rationale: All 15 findings clearly scoped; no deep rediscovery needed; findings map to g84 roadmap; no system-level risks identified
